name: Super Star Destroyer
description: Super Star Destroyer (SSD) was a term used by Imperial, Rebel, New Republic and Galactic Alliance personnel for many dagger-shaped warship classes larger than Star Destroyers, ranging from Star Cruiser to Star Dreadnought models.

data.name: Super Star Destroyer
type: Battlecruiser (in the Anaxes War College System)
Dreadnaught (in the Anaxes War College System)
armament: Individual designs also utilized either assault concussion missile launchers, Gravity well projectors or superlaser cannons
